body: One precise question can reveal much more than another hour spent arguing with the surface version of the problem. When Mercury sextiles Pluto, thought and depth cooperate, helping research, negotiation, and difficult conversations reach the information with actual leverage behind it. Follow the discrepancy, ask for the missing detail, or revisit the part of the story that never quite added up. Ask the one surgical question that unlocks the leverage holding the entire dynamic together. You don't need a full confession; you just need the single fact that dictates your next strategic move.
